data.title: Qatari mediators fly to Tehran to finalize deal, end Iran war | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Pakistan is now preparing for an electronic signing expected within the next 24 hours, followed by technical-level talks next week, according to Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.
